patterns.note: Alternating high-contrast blocks of deep charcoal and clinical light gray to separate high-level conceptual branding from technical product specifications.
Technical monospace labels and numbers paired with a clean, geometric sans-serif for headings, evoking an industrial, military-grade engineering aesthetic.
A stark palette of black, white, and concrete gray punctuated by a high-visibility safety orange accent for interactive elements and technical indicators.
A scroll-bound interactive 3D wireframe sequence that rotates and reveals shelter components alongside a sticky vertical progress indicator as the user scrolls through the core concept section.
A structured 'Operational protection matrix' grid using custom technical icons and clean borders to break down complex engineering standards.

technique_notes: To recreate the technical wireframe effect, use a scroll-driven canvas animation or a sequence of pre-rendered 3D frames tied to scroll depth using GSAP ScrollTrigger, allowing the shelter model to rotate and highlight specific components as the user scrolls.
Implement a strict grid system with subtle vertical lines and crosshair markers on section corners to establish a blueprint-like, high-precision engineering atmosphere.
Use CSS backdrop-filters on sticky navigation bars to maintain legibility while transitioning smoothly over high-contrast dark and light sections.

design_tokens.type_scale: Clean, medium-weight geometric headings paired with tiny, uppercase monospace labels and structured body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners on all structural blocks, cards, and buttons, reinforcing the rigid, industrial, and fortified nature of the product.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious in the editorial dark sections, transitioning to a highly organized, balanced grid layout for product listings and technical specifications.

standout: The site masterfully blends high-end architectural luxury with military-grade technical precision, using interactive 3D wireframes and a blueprint-inspired grid system to make survival shelters feel like premium, state-of-the-art technology.
